changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate model entry and simplified output descriptions. 'Creative Story Generation' was redundant with 'Story Generation'.
Consolidated duplicate metrics and removed redundant descriptions. Kept base metric names without implementation details.
Cleaned up empty fields. The paper does not use LLMs as judges after generation.

guideline: Participants were given the task to describe themselves both as their self-identified racial identity and an imagined one (prompts are in Table).

changes_made.explanation: Corrected answer from 'No' to 'No' (no change needed) but removed the human evaluation metadata. The paper mentions human-written personas from prior work (So & Roland 2020), but does not conduct new human evaluations of the LLM-generated outputs.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating stereotypes in LLM-generated personas and stories using automatic methods. The human-written personas are from a prior study (So & Roland 2020) and are used as a baseline comparison, but no new human evaluation of LLM outputs is conducted. The extraction was generally accurate but included some redundant items and incorrectly suggested human evaluation was conducted in this paper.
